column1: # Probability of each letter in a nucleotide and in an amino acid sequence.
# aa: amino acid composition of UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot release 2026_04, https://web.expasy.org/docs/relnotes/relstat.html
# nucl: model values. U has the probability of T, as U replaces T in RNA.
# B (IUPAC C/G/T, and Asx) has the same probability in both columns.
